chip.summary: A few tips before you continue

modal.title: A quick tip on this photo
modal.subtitle: A clearer photo usually gives a better result — but it's your call. Use this one, or try again with the tips below.

warnings.mildBlur: This photo looks a little soft.
warnings.mildDark: This photo is a little dark.
warnings.mildBright: This photo is a little bright.
warnings.oddAspect: This photo has an unusual shape.

tips.severeBlur: Tip: tap the food on your screen to focus, then hold steady.
tips.mildBlur: Tip: tap the food on your screen to focus before snapping.
tips.severeDark: Tip: move near a window or switch on more light.
tips.mildDark: Tip: a bit more light will make the dish pop.
tips.severeBright: Tip: move out of direct glare or harsh sunlight.
tips.mildBright: Tip: soften the light or angle away from the glare.
tips.tooSmall: Tip: move closer to the dish and use your main camera.
tips.lowRes: Tip: get a little closer so the dish fills the frame.
tips.oddAspect: Tip: frame the dish square-on, filling most of the photo.
